notes.title: StarRupture: Developer Update - June '25
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/75567d10c2e0e02a5deeeb4cb5eb512afd780085.jpg"]

Hello everyone!

Welcome to our fresh and exciting Developer Update. This month, we’re inviting you to check out our co-op mode in action, and we’re sharing more info about the effects of the scorching fire wave, and how you can unlock your inner interior designer.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/e1cb02b9a4215096823b3509391ef87d1e5a453c.png"]
[previewyoutube="sLRb7-OuHag;full"][/previewyoutube]

After publishing the newest extensive look at StarRupture co-op gameplay video, we have received a ton of feedback and comments! Thank you for being so active, this helps us understand what you’re most excited about in the game and lets us answer at least some of your questions in this Developer Update. 

  

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/3ab97063cc086577d2c4a96940a5657c74380431.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/eed1507c00b231eadead136283747dbb38338fcc.gif"]


The event of the Ruptura’s Fire Wave brings a lot of danger for every living being on the Arcadia-7 planet. But you know what they say - “better safe than sorry”. And that’s where Base Core comes into play. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/b0e3d341a2cdfd5547aad6a6fed4fee2baf78cbf.gif"]


The passage of the wave of fire does not mean that our base will be wiped out - thanks to the brilliant invention of the Selenian Corp -  Base Cores. Base Cores - crucial for setting up your base - protect and cool down the buildings within their perimeter.  

You will also be able to level up the Base Cores so they will be able to restore the factory operations even faster… but it will come at a price, and we’re not necessarily only speaking here about the resources needed to do it…

[previewyoutube="SX5A063JKb4;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="rQ3ctvERoBE;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="UifkRFNJkIY;full"][/previewyoutube]
 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]

 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/967517a710c4bb314e78d24c900bfa70c00b0903.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8c1912809bfdca49716ad19001e1ca84ba890b4d.png"]

In StarRupture, you and your friends will be able to not only scratch the itch of creating your own, custom factories but also cool and chilling-looking habitats. 

The Habitats you will build across the planet’s surface will be your safe spots. They’re not only perfect hideouts to stock & refill your supplies and plan your next actions, but also great places to hide from the scorching heat or waves of enemies.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/95b46d77e711101449f211f00c801a02edecda01.png"]

With the building tool, you will be able to create your habitats on the flat lands of the planet, or even more wicked designs on the hill sides. 

You will be able to customize your habitats with additional segments and combine them with vertical or horizontal connectors, add additional airlocks for entrances, and viewports for an extra look at the vistas. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/57c5378a8ff0ad68eaa8d4b52381fe0a45beddda.png"]

You will also be able to freely decide where to place your storage, progression, and crafting machines. Hopefully, your vision will align with that of your teammates, but if it doesn’t, you can always build another habitat in a different location.

We can’t wait to see the creative designs of your habitats you will make in StarRupture. 

  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ad7f14bf4623df3b35594a618d6c0e27d620a2b7.png"]
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8799cb0ae1469f158851b2cd70df002cc5017b9a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/ad5f34b0171b157f274db8eb8d547413d6c2524e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/d45feac2126553f6a67082f9e55196e9848d464e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/5fc09f12c320ab912935c32303190a62ff26b1f6.png"][/carousel]
In StarRupture, you will be able to take your 3 friends on a mission in which you will extract, automate, and ship the resources from the Arcadia-7 planet.  


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/340575dc680100ca280480b8ded5ccbd01151058.png"]

You will mark a new chapter in the history of humanity - and the future of the Claywood Corporation - the company that sent you across the galaxy to explore and document this undiscovered world.   


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/8adb55d042144c16fc5228a3f96f980545f77ed1.png"]

As you progress further, you will uncover different resources that need different machinery to collect them. They have one thing in common, though - Drone Rails. They will not only function as a transportation route to connect them with other machinery or storage buildings, but also as a means to transfer the energy needed to power them.    

 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/63b55d5ed3eaa8e898051f9e40c292c35e2791a5.png"]
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/fb0521fafd8da4e52b5c6fc71fb00fc6f50a7323.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/dceb1bdf3f33288626ef4a72eab2b07fb3d0cd76.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/585d37ae0b50f0e0540839b685129889e4cad26e.png"][/carousel]
Last month, we showed you the monoliths - now… we’d like to show you how they’ve changed! 

They’re now much harder to find - that’s for sure! And they are very much connected to the base defense… but we will reveal more about it later on.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/2b2bc035f681f9d471f07b3a59e202bf792fdeb8.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238153/04a2e9a8097ef61ae8ddf26612655282f3309231.png"]



And that’s all for our StarRupture Developer Update in June - we hope you’ve enjoyed the never-before-seen content and that you’re hungry for more! 

Stay tuned for our fresh & exciting updates on socials and right here on Steam as well, as we’re on our road to the Autumn 2025 Early Access launch.  



Until next time,  
Creepy Jar Team

notes.title: Free Update #21 - Decorations | Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers,

The 21st, Free Update for Green Hell is now available!

The entire team had so much fun while creating this update. We were constantly giving each other new ideas about what could also be added to it, that in its final form, there’s so much new stuff to play with! See them in the trailer below:
[previewyoutube=ERz2eKEZlJM;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png

New mechanic: Painting 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/3cf693fcba26b86bf1e8afe27c1e0a43fd180d9d.gif

Yes! Now you can paint all kinds of constructions & the newly added decorations. 

After you equip yourself with Paints made from different bugs and other colorful elements, you can create your Paintbrush out of some Fiber, Rope, and a Stick. That is how you can paint your base and color your furniture! Just pick a tint from our Amazonian color collection: white, blue, red, green, or yellow, and make the jungle even more vibrant! 

This mechanic will work with the newly added decorations and the items that you’ve already constructed as well! So be creative, and let your imagination go wild!

New construction: Workbench
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/ed9025f71f8580311d0e5a153d991d58c4fdc0ac.gif

The Workbench definitely will be your new best friend with this update. It will enable crafting all different kinds of decorations for your base. 

New constructions: Decorations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/cd02120adf9c313808cd89e8ffce00962fe152aa.jpg
So… much… new… stuff… to… decorate… your… base!!!

With the use of the Workbench, you will be able to craft yourself some serious furniture items which will make your home-sweet-home even more cozy! You can craft a Table, a Chair, a Bench, a Night Stand and various Paintings to set a proper mood, or even mount some Animal Trophies to show off your hunting skills to others! 

As something extra, we’ve also prepared some Rope, Leaf, and Bone Decorations for those who like pretty (or creepy!) stuff.

New constructions: Armor Stand & Arrow Holder
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/698d88c45a5306f26bdcedddc80c44f36efe10ae.jpg
You’ve asked for it, and there we have it! 

Thanks to these new Stands you will be able to store your Arrows securely and showcase your neatly crafted Armors on a display they deserve. 

New constructions: Torch Stand & Torch Holder
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/dbc0b1256788839b089a050837e26b978c7768c8.gif

Now these are constructions, we’ve been cooking for a long time. They’ve been sitting in our backlog for years now, but now we’ve got the right tools to complete them and make them shine! 

You can place the Torch Holders inside your base to set a proper mood at night, and use the Torch Stands at strategic points on the map to easily direct you in the wilderness. Just remember - the torches won’t be burning forever and you will need to maintain them if you don’t want to be suddenly surrounded by the darkness of the night again.

New mechanic: Rearranging
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/e0dbff8c9c28b1fb18628a619e7728ee91e3e0b1.gif

Thanks to this new mechanic, you can rearrange the decorations you’ve created and move them to another place. 

Don’t like the table standing in the corner? No problem, you can just move it to the nearby window. The painting is not looking great on that wall, huh? Just move it aside, or place it along the collection of your other paintings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/82d485db0b6cad68816d586c157a53972971fe91.jpg


CELEBRATE WITH CAPYBARA PLUSHIE
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/cabf4c94d1bfbe23ac4d7ddbe9ee71d83fc5b527.jpg
Additionally, as part of our Green Hell Anniversary celebration, we’ve teamed up with Makeship to bring you for the very first time an official Green Hell merch!

This lovely Capybara looks cute, but - in fact - is ready for some serious survival action with its cute Green Hell gear. Equipped with Stone Axe and Machete, Capybara can go out and seek adventures both in the vast Amazonian Rainforest or even in the nooks and crannies of your gaming rooms… Cappy in her backpack also carries a banana - as nutrition is really important when you’re exploring the wilderness!

https://www.makeship.com/products/green-hell-capybara-plushie


Be sure to secure your Cappy Plushie, as the campaign is time-limited!



AN IMPORTANT MESSAGE FROM CREEPY JAR
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/4f81dc0993aa9f06e9045ef674c8037530267ca3.jpg
Our adventure with Green Hell comes to an end with this free content update. Since the release of the game in the 1.0 version back in 2019, we’ve been updating it regularly with free content updates - including the huge 3-part story mode “Spirits of Amazonia”, as well as gameplay changing updates like the “Building Update” and “Storage & Transportation”, or completely new additional gameplay enriching mechanics as "Fortifications" & "Flamekeeper". And now - with teary eyes - we’ve decided to publish this one more and final update to the game and make the Green Hell experience complete.

The game won’t be getting any more new content updates on PC, but it will still be supported by our team.

We’re super grateful for your support throughout the years, for the feedback you’ve been providing us with, for the stories you’ve told us about your experience, and for the adventures you’ve lived in the game. This fueled us to provide you with even more opportunities to craft new stories and have even more adventures in Green Hell. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/60360500a7aaa64ed682e9e00a62500b584f7ca3.jpg
Now it’s time for us to prepare another adventure for you - the whole team is now working hard on our next big title. We are devoted to make it a great title fused with the experience gained and lessons learned while creating Green Hell, and the things you’ve told us you loved about our game. So we hope we will see you soon in our own new sci-fi universe - in StarRupture.

Yours truly,
Creepy Jar Team

notes.title: Free Update #20 - Anteater | Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers,

Today is the day! We are proud to announce that the Free Update #20 for Green Hell - "Anteater" is available now! 

The name of our latest free update hides many more new & fresh features than the name might suggest. Alongside having added new animals to your Animal Pen, we’ve prepared a bunch of cool mechanics and enhancements to the rest of the game. See the Anteater in action in the newest trailer, and if you’d like to dive into the update’s details - see the notes below.

[previewyoutube=XZ7FggBdlmU;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png

New animal: Giant Anteater
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/f6c34cab534f56947e13c41fd4bb7264cbbebcb2.gif
The most exciting part of this update is the Giant Anteater. Some call him amusing, some think he’s cute, but he can be very aggressive - so you need to watch out! 
Naturally, you will be able to find this beast near anthills. He’s usually shy and will try to avoid you, but when threatened - he will not hesitate to use his claws to protect himself and might deal you great damage.


New mechanic: Spawning anthills
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/59b912c6adcb335d70099d98ff1c9f70917df2dd.jpg
You may remember anthills from Green Hell before, stepping inside them and getting those pesky ants crawling all over you, or collecting the ants to mend your laceration wounds. But now, anthills may also serve as your guidepost to the place anteaters hang out most.

Until now, the only thing you could have done is either avoid or harvest an anthill. But now you can also destroy them! Destroying an anthill won’t provide you with more ants, but if you find an anthill standing in your way to build something, or if it blocks your path and you keep bumping into it, you will be able to remove it. Don’t worry, though; ants will always find a new spot to build a new house for their colony, so from now on a new anthill will soon appear in a nearby area. With some more animals looking for them, including the infamous anteater and… an armadillo?!


New mechanic: New animals in your animal pen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/ab5ca4912f408b0993e0004e46ccd90da78445ce.jpg
The Animal Husbandry update introduced the ability to breed some of the animal species from the jungle. Now, we are adding even more animals to your menagerie, as you will be able to breed Armadillos, Three-banded Armadillos, and - of course - Giant Anteaters!


New construction: Composter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/91bd6769a085586b9dfec90af0a10716ef341911.png
Thanks to this simple construction you will be able to dispose of such things as rotten meat, spoiled food, leaves, animal drops, and everything organic in general - and not necessarily only expired things! As a product of such action, you will receive compost (see more details about this new item in the section below), and insects with which you will be able to feed your pack of Armadillos and Anteaters.


New item: Compost
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/90a4a0931b03dc39b6fcaa90a9a6bc5a73de8654.gif
Show your plants some love with the new, organic, homemade superfood - Compost!
Compost is the most important and most fertilizing product of the Composter. With this nutritious and rich substance, you can elevate your planting skills to a higher level! 


New construction: Feeding Trough - Insects
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/21d2669ab5b017b730e96cbb8d852295172072b9.png
As you now have some new pals to take care of in your animal pen, you will need a way to feed them. By using this new construction, you will be able to feed anteaters and armadillos with insects. Bon appétit!


New mechanic: Parrot keeping
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/998b018fa21f4abedf35ea583f497a03a5ed32a8.gif
Now you can lure parrots into your base - or any other place where you build a Parrot Nest - where parrots can fly into and become accustomed to your presence.


New construction: Parrot Nest
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/04cd231222eccc459ac9c4d662e9fa9c269e8627.png
When you manage to get parrots safe and comfy in your Parrot Nest, you will be rewarded with feathers and eggs left by the birds. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/9f3e1f5311e2b75c3d3d52f56f53517d4e247681.png
And that’s all in this #20 free content update! As usual, thank you so much for supporting the game. We welcome all your thoughts and feedback on our discord server.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/1916f8b037064d73130a67e42694c1d352bdb51d.gif
Last but not least, keep your eyes peeled for our next update for Green Hell! Be sure it will make your Amazonian home super cozy!

Happy anteating!
Creepy Jar Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/52956470226aefe62b17426e6ba0a3d5fdbeadf3.png

PS. 
Aside from supporting Green Hell with new free updates, we're hard at work on our next title, StarRupture. Being built in Unreal Engine 5, StarRupture is an ambitious cross between base building, exploration, combat, and resource management on an alien planet torn by a catastrophic cycle of destruction. notes.title: Storage & Transportation Update is out now!
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers!
The Storage & Transportation Update is officially live and available for free for all Steam players! 

[previewyoutube=ooscPx_31EQ;full][Trailer]
[/previewyoutube]

As many of Green Hell’s most experienced players know, efficiency is of the utmost importance if you want to survive in the Amazon jungle. To stay efficient, your base needs perfect space management which improves the process of gathering the necessary food supplies or materials. In addition, every trip across the rainforest puts you in untold danger, so why make more trips than is needed? 

Storage and Transportation patch will help you with that, so just check out what's new:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/185d57bd83b3e7c3ad142d9c4f8bc96df62955f5.png

Sled
A great tool for transporting heavy objects. What’s more, you can put up to two different types of Heavy Objects in one Sled.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/b04b9e475fdcdbc2b2578381ff586107cde82f53.gif

We know how much players like to build vast and complex bases. Resources near the base may quickly run out and you have to go deeper and deeper into the jungle for materials. We decided to speed up material transport by adding sleds, to help our players spend more time building and less time running around for materials. 

Elevator 
Treehouse or multi-story villa, the elevator is the new easier way of transporting heavy resources up and down. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/f218293c672127b9e14a9d2dad7b064c4d9ec98d.gif

In the last building update, we added new construction to build a treehouse. We noticed that transporting a large amount of materials to the upper floors using a ladder is inconvenient, so we decided to add a new construction - an elevator.

Shelf and Hanging Shelf
A new type of universal storage, in which you can unpack most of the items from your Backpack - excluding weapons and building materials such as sticks (they still need to be put on dedicated stands). Thanks to the new shelves, you can see the status of your stock at a glance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/8f7d90aafe2c6f1e811f70868c765130f3f4369b.png

We felt that there should be a universal storage for smaller items in Green Hell, where you can see what items it contains without interaction and from a distance. This type of shelf is also aesthetic and looks nice in the base.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/c0afb173cc6c0e47b302f47784c5078f459e1ba1.png

Quick Pick Up
With the option to turn off animation delay for picking up items you no longer have to wait for animation to complete to pick another item. The faster you click, the faster you pick.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/5be64d6b22bdc0e295cf1dd9268f21253abc1049.gif

After adding the elevator and sled, we noticed that the delay in the pick-up animation was disrupting the dynamics of the resource harvesting process. That's why we decided to remove this delay. However, during our beta testing, we received feedback that this change affects immersion for some players, so we decided to add the option to disable this improvement in the game options.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/400b72c742444b8f2a3b7e1e06368a2c9bafa2e4.png

Baskets
A reworked version of the Small and Big Stone Stands are renamed to Baskets and now can hold various types of objects, such as stones, bones, planks, green coconuts, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/f6f91791dac59990efa0e04cbf467afc432c5ca8.jpg
As we aim for immersion we thought that the stone basket looks like it can hold similar items, so instead of making new types, we decided to make our stone stands more versatile. Now you can choose what to use it for.

New Bamboo versions of Stands
Every storage construction now has its bamboo version. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/62d5494f117ba9661b1dee968255fe6c603f1b53.png

Since The Building Update, we have been trying to give players the opportunity to build their base using any materials. We noticed some wooden structures did not have their bamboo counterparts at all. So, while working on Storage and Transportation Update we wanted to improve the storage system as well by adding a missing bamboo stands.


One universal Leaf Stand 
Leaf Stand now has two slots. You can choose what materials you want to stack in each slot: Banana or Palm leaves. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/6ebdf0d7e2b159836e3f05f629f0f0cd58e74852.png

Universal  Wood Stands
Stands for logs and sticks made of bamboo or wood can store both wood and bamboo materials in each, e.g. wooden materials can be stored in bamboo racks.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/0aff429d91b2008e1d522c076c69e8d550836a06.png

So far, the rack system has been very restrictive. For example, to store a Bamboo Log, the player had to build a rack using the same material. It wasn't exactly the optimal solution. So we decided to give players a little more freedom and the ability to change the type of stored material when the structure is already built.

Increased capacity of Stands 
All stands have now increased capacity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/d1668840c8053157d157faf18e8651ea5b10ef31.png
Since The Building Update, we've been trying to encourage players to build bigger and bigger bases. After playtests, it turned out that the current capacity of material storage structures is simply too small and players have to devote more and more space for these structures.

Improved item storing & pick-up mechanic
Now you can place and take out an item in storage with a single button, and take it out with another.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791864/bcc715f2a8c1a31ae6049075ae16c326edb64f07.png

 Elevator - A new, much easier way of transporting heavy resources to both your base's upper floors and Tree Houses.
 Shelf - Introducing a new universal storage option where you can store and display most of the items from your Backpack excluding weapons and sticks.
 Hanging Shelf - Now you can add more storage space with the first wall add-ons. Adding shelving onto walls will free up space for players elsewhere in their houses.
 Small Storage Basket - An improved version of the Small Stone Stand, the Small Storage Basket can hold various types of objects: Stone, Obsidian Stone, Charcoal, Bone, Plank, etc.

- Improved item storing & removing mechanic: Players can now place an item in storage with a single button push and take it out with another.
 Removed animation delay for picking up items: Players no longer have to wait for an animation to complete to pick up another item. The faster one clicks, the faster one picks!

notes.title: Green Hell Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Creepy Jar is excited to announce that Green Hell will be leaving Early Acces and launching 1.0 at: Sept 5, 2019

Watch the Story Mode Teaser Trailer Now!:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M4LKRG2GdYk&feature=youtu.be

Releasing into Early Access in August of 2018, Green Hell comes full circle just over one year later as it launches into version 1.0. 

Continuing our focus on listening to the Green Hell community, Creepy Jar has also implemented a number of changes and fixes to coincide with the 1.0 launch update. See a list of the major additions in the update below;

Story Mode and 1.0 Update Additions:

●	Story Mode! — How did you end up in the Amazon? What happened to your love, Mia? How can you escape? How can you survive? Seeking answers to these questions will take you to the brink of sanity as you rediscover well known areas and discover new areas for the first time.
●	New Map Areas — The lush rainforest of Green Hell gets even bigger with new Wetlands to explore.
●	Perma-Death Difficulty — Gear up for the most ruthless challenge yet. There’s no coming back from death.
●	New Graphics Options — Optimize your experience with new FOV, Vsync, antialiasing, texture quality, and shadow distance options.
●	New Plants and Animals — Introducing the psychosis-inducing Psychotria Viridis, the banisteriopsis Caapi, and the lethally poisonous Dart Frog.
●	Decay Timer— Many items in the game will now start to wither and decay. Players will have to be vigilant learning to use their items before they expire.
●	Custom Game Settings – Have a problem with snakes? Maybe spiders? Introducing new options to turn tribes, predators, spiders, snakes, and the sanity meter on or off! Hate managing macroelements? Green Hell is also adding a depletion speed slider to adjust how quickly you need to replenish yourself.

Thank you for surviving with us!
